quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) press release: Resonac Invests in Matter Venture Partners Fund II as a (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Resonac's U.S. subsidiary Resonac America, Inc. made a strategic investment as a limited partner in Matter Venture Partners Fund II, L.P. (Los Altos, California; fund size USD 450 million; invests in early-stage hard-tech startups including next-generation semiconductors, AI infrastructure and Physical AI) to accelerate R&D and identify new business opportunities; Resonac's own commitment amount is not stated. The release also states that Resonac launched US-JOINT, a U.S. R&D consortium for next-generation semiconductor packaging, in July 2024 and that it officially commenced operations in April 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Fund II size USD 450 million (Resonac's commitment not stated); US-JOINT operations commenced April 2026
